overviewMarkdown:
# satware® AI image

**Professional image generation and editing** powered by Google Gemini, with advanced prompt enhancement, quality presets, and industry-specific optimization.

## Functions

1. **generate_image** - Create new images from text descriptions (1-4 images per call)
2. **edit_image** - Modify an uploaded image OR a previously-generated image in the same conversation (tool-chaining)

## Smart Prompt Enhancement

- **9 Professional Presets**: Photography, Promotional Products, Corporate Branding, etc.
- **Custom Enhancement**: Manual prompt optimization input
- **Industry Focus**: Automotive, Healthcare, Technology, Finance, and more
- **Brand Compliance**: Strict Corporate, Creative Corporate, Luxury Premium, etc.

## Quality Presets

- **Maximum Consistency**: Brand-consistent content (temp 0.2, topP 0.7, topK 20)
- **Balanced**: Professional quality with creativity (0.7/0.9/40)
- **Creative Exploration**: Maximum artistic freedom (0.9/0.95/80)
- **Custom**: Full manual control

## Models

| Model | Use case |
|-------|----------|
| gemini-3-pro-image (default) | Best capability, character consistency, multi-turn editing |
| gemini-3.1-flash-image | Fast, lower cost |
| gemini-2.5-flash-image | Legacy nano banana |

## Performance & Pricing

| Model | Cost/image | Resolution |
|-------|------------|------------|
| gemini-3-pro-image | ~$0.134 (1K/2K), ~$0.24 (4K) | up to 4K |
| gemini-3.1-flash-image | See pricing page | up to 2K |
| gemini-2.5-flash-image | $0.039 | 1024px |

All outputs include SynthID watermarking.
Free tier availability varies by model; see pricing page for details.
Full pricing: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing

## Setup

1. Get a Gemini API key: https://aistudio.google.com/app/apikey
2. Enter the key in plugin settings (required)
3. (Optional) Choose a prompt enhancement mode and quality preset
4. Start generating - ask the AI to create or edit an image

## Usage Examples

**Generate**: "Generate a professional headshot of a business executive"
**Edit**: [upload image] "Make this brighter and more professional"
**Corporate**: Set enhancement to Corporate Branding + Technology, quality to Maximum Consistency, then: "Product launch presentation slide"

*Powered by satware® AI*

dynamicContextEndpoints.name: generate_image guidance
dynamicContextEndpoints.staticContent: Use generate_image to create NEW images from a text prompt. Supports 1-4 images per call (n parameter) and style presets. ALSO accepts uploaded reference images: if the user uploads an image of a character or object and asks to place it in a new scene, use generate_image (it sends the reference as inlineData alongside the scene prompt for character/object consistency). For modifying an existing uploaded or previously-generated image in place, use edit_image instead. After generation, images render as cards in the chat.

dynamicContextEndpoints.name: edit_image guidance
dynamicContextEndpoints.staticContent: Use edit_image to MODIFY an existing image. The image can be either (a) uploaded by the user as an attachment, or (b) produced by a previous generate_image or edit_image call in the same conversation (tool-chaining). The prompt describes the edit. ALSO composites/blends multiple uploaded images: if the user uploads 2+ images (e.g. a primary scene and a logo) and asks to project one onto the other, use edit_image (it sends all images as inlineData and instructs the model to composite with correct perspective, lighting, and shadows). For creating new images from scratch (no input image), use generate_image instead.
